notes.title: Update v1.1.0 : Steam Workshop + Streamers web source
notes.content:
[h1]What's new :[/h1]

[b]- You can now browse and share your presets with the community ![/b]
    There is a new tab available showing your subscribed items.
    You can create your own items by using the Editor available in advanced mode.

[b]- Streamers Addon[/b]
    You now have access to a web source to add in your favorite broadcasting software, to show when your devices are kicking in real-time

[b]- Bug patch[/b]
    Corrected a bug in the Demo tab, where the "Auto-shoot" button wouldn't kick when the channel "All" was selected.



If you have questions or suggestions, you can reach us on our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/kAsGHs2]Discord server[/url]

Have a good day :)

notes.title: Patch v1.0.1 : French documentation and bugfix for demo mode
notes.content:
[h2]What's new :[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Changed P90 rumble power from 30 to 75[/b]
Corrects the squeaking sound from the vibrations modules for forcetube-explorer users.
You will still experience squeaking if the rumble is set to low values.

[*][b] Correction of a bug on auto-kick[/b]
 That feature would kick once in two times when you clicked on the button.

[*] [b]French documentation[/b]
You can now access the French website documentation if you run the app in french language.
The documentation button at the bottom-left of the app will automatically load the french version if you manually changed the language.
[/list]


If you have questions or suggestions, you can talk with us on our official [url=https://discord.com/invite/kAsGHs2]Discord server[/url]

Have a good day :)
